name: Verification support (first draft)
description: First knowledge pack for the verification / applicant-support domain. Built only from vocabulary found in the existing application code, message templates, stored tickets and messages, and the existing rule lexicons. It is a DRAFT: nothing in it is a business-approved rule yet.
reviewNotes: Every entry carries an origin (where the vocabulary came from) and a review value: approved | established | needs_review.
established = found in existing code, templates, stored data or lexicons, but not yet approved by the business. needs_review = inferred or taken from an example; it must be confirmed or removed.
A pack may only be marked approved when every entry is approved. Set KNOWLEDGE_REQUIRE_APPROVED=true in production to refuse draft packs.
Nothing here comes from a real business rulebook: refunds, timelines, policies and verification outcomes are deliberately absent.
